hook.name: RetardV112PoolGuardHook
hook.description: A non-accounting guard hook for one-sided ETH/coin pools. beforeInitialize authenticates that the pool is canonical (correct fee/tickSpacing, coin must identify the initializer as its market). afterSwap reverts if the post-swap price exceeds the pool's opening tick boundary, preventing a partial sell from walking the pool above its real-native opening price.
